ModMetaData.name: Archotech: Unbreakable Implants
ModMetaData.author: Snat
ModMetaData.description:
Archotech implants can never be destroyed.
When damage would otherwise destroy an archotech implant, the implant breaks instead: its body part drops to minimal condition (0%) and the implant stops providing its bonus. Archotech self-repair then brings that part back to 100% over roughly one in-game day.
The implant, and the part carrying it, can no longer be blown off - damage is capped rather than fatal.
Requires Harmony.
